manifest.name: gdn-fp8-mlp-q4k-zo-deep-q4k
manifest.description: FP8 on recurrent qkv and shallow z, Q4_K on deep z and out, Q4_K on the MLP after layer 0, and lm_head stored BF16 so its batch-1 Q4_K is fitted once. The full-MLP FP8 map is the lowest-drift point on the frontier; moving only the deep z and out off FP8 is meant to keep that drift and return decode and memory. MLP layer 0 and attention stay NVFP4.
